name: lift-off-table
_comment: RECOVERY, forced on purpose. The arm fell onto the table when torque was cut on a strain stop, so the START pose is already in contact and the gate refuses EVERY trajectory out of it - correctly, and unhelpfully. This is the one move that cannot make it worse: j4 tips the wrist UP, lifting the lowest hand point from -8.3 mm to +25.7 mm, measured in the twin. Nothing else moves. Run with --force, then use a normally-gated clip from there.
